# SZC — Digital Solutions
SZC is an independent digital solutions company founded by Shaaz Zakariya C, based in Kannur, Kerala, India and working with clients worldwide.

## Capabilities
- Logo design and brand identity
- Website design and development
- E-commerce websites and landing pages
- Web application and custom software development
- iOS and Android mobile application development
- Business dashboards and internal systems
- AI automation and integrations
- Domain registration, hosting setup, and website maintenance
